book.name: 1 Korint
book.title: Korint Quraŋ 1 Polji Korint yoŋore Quraŋ fuŋfuŋgaine ruaya.

content: Jerusalem ogo babapi yabeniminde mimiti

Judia kufufuŋ gbagbataeŋine yoŋore ogo babapi moneŋ roru qojuganimiŋgo weu narebuŋ, ore eru iŋi mitiga ŋarego: Nonji Galesia prowinsre maŋkekerisie kufufuŋine kufufuŋine mitiga yare foreboŋ, ŋoŋoji oŋuakoŋ ore so iŋi eku goinebi.

Sonda so una fuŋfuŋgaine oo ŋoŋo sosowo bubu pesiŋ ruaeinebi. Yauŋmoriri roegobi so moneŋ-ŋaŋuŋ mobeine oi rouŋ-ŋaŋunde qaŋaŋineo ruaru siŋaŋ garu goinebi. Oŋu ruabi nonji damaŋ mogo ŋoŋoreo warebe oo pesiŋ biobio ruanimiŋ ore so oŋu so einebiyoŋ, oi soine rouŋ-ŋaŋuŋgone roru alatao ruainebi.
Oŋu ruabi ŋoŋoreo warebemiŋ, nonji damaŋ oo soine mimitaniŋ quraŋ quraŋgaru ŋi gio ore manebi sagaga, yoŋore meo ruaru sore yabebe qoqodure yauŋ-ŋaŋuŋ oi roru Jerusalem ranimiŋ.
Nonji yoŋoke moko rabeminde rabemiŋ ine, yoŋoji soine noke jikigaru moko koe petigaru rakimiŋ. Oŋu.
Polre giore eru kadi rarare buru
Nonji Masedonia prowins odureru rabemiŋ. Ore eru Masedonia bokeru ŋoŋoreo warebeminde manego.
Ŋoŋoreo wareru damaŋ goine ŋoŋoke ŋenobo me kueyoiko damaŋ (winter) oi oŋuakoŋ ŋoŋore botugo jikigaru go forenobo. Oŋu gobe soine bapi nubi uro ranobo, oo afagaru kadi jikigaru rabemiŋ.
Damaŋ yoo ŋoŋoreo wareru yayaba akoŋ ŋone ŋaberu ŋadureru rabemiŋgo so manegoyoŋ, Ofonji o miiŋ ine, damaŋ goine ŋoŋoke ŋeiŋgo jauego.
Oŋu jauegoyoŋ, rone Efesus siti yoo jikigaru gobe gosa minebobo gariine (pentekost) oiji ware fukeiŋ.
Anutuji nonde giore mendi soguine rome soine gio soguine babe foriine fukeru saueegayoŋ, kokoineji kiso enareegobi. Ore eru yoo jikigaru gobemiŋ ore manego.
Timotiji noŋ oŋuine Ofonde ŋi yoine fukeru gioine baku goga. Ore eru iŋoji ŋoŋoreo wareiŋ ine, ŋoŋo siŋaŋ gatebi kokoi mamaneine tomiri ŋoŋore botugo goiŋ.
Moji mo so takireru mipemiriŋ eineyoŋ, ŋoŋoke gokame tariko nondeo wareiŋgo miiŋ, oo bapi gabi womoo boke ŋaberu kirieru wareiŋ. Nonji maŋkekerisie ogopune yoŋoke oi ŋoneiŋgo odigagobeneŋ.

Maŋkekerisie ogonoŋuŋ Apolos iŋore buŋo oi iŋi mibemiŋ: Iŋoji maŋkekerisie ogopune yoŋoke ŋoŋoreo wareiŋ ore buŋo sanaŋine ojiru maŋine bapakare teboŋ. Oŋu bapakare teboŋyoŋ, damaŋ yoo ŋoŋoreo wareiŋ ore maŋine sanaŋgako takigaga. Jiki damaŋine soine pe teiŋ, oo wareiŋ. Oŋu.
Momojo buŋo tatariine
Ŋoŋo maŋgarigari goku mamanesiŋ-ŋaŋuŋ kegboreru sanaŋgaru goinebi. Ŋi sanaŋinere so mande kikitiŋ ŋiŋigo fukeru Ofonde usuŋke dimainebi.
Ya sosowo eku eboenimiŋ, oi manji jojoko paio ebi fukeiŋ.

Stefanas iŋore pigo gogobi, ŋoŋo oi mane yabegobi. Akaia prowinsgo gio babeneŋ maŋyaŋuŋ kerisiebi gionoŋunde fori fuŋfuŋgaine oŋu fukeya, oi manegobi. Yoŋoji ŋiŋigo gbagbataeŋine oi gbeŋ akoŋ kiŋaŋ qa yareku maŋyaŋuŋ oo kiperu ruaku gogobi, oi manegobi. O maŋkekerisie ogopune, nonji maŋ-ŋaŋuŋ iŋi bapakarego:
Ŋoŋo oŋuakoŋ ŋiŋigo oŋuine eru yoŋoke jikigaru gio moko baku Anutu kiŋaŋ qa teegobi, sosowo yoŋore buŋo rurumaŋgo raru goinebi.
Nonji Stefanas, Fortunatus eru Akaikus yoo warebi ore jerieego. Ŋoŋo noke Efesus yoo so gogobi yoŋoji ŋoŋore tife fukeru aŋibaŋi enarebi sagaga.
Yoŋoji ŋoŋore iiru beufi qaku gogobi, ore so nonde iiru oŋuakoŋ beufi qa noreku gobuŋ. Ore eru ŋoŋo ŋi oŋuine yoŋore manebi ropeko oi totogo akoŋ miku buŋoyaŋunde poretiŋ kaje ruaru goinebi.

Maŋkekerisie kufufuŋine kufufuŋine Eisia prowins yoo gogobi, yoŋoji momojoyaŋuŋ ruabi ŋoŋoreo foga. Akwila, Prisila eru maŋkekerisie kufufuŋ yokore pigo tumaŋgaegobi, yoŋoji Ofonde tinao momojoyaŋuŋ kokoine ruabi ŋoŋoreo foga.
Maŋkekerisie ogopune sosowo Efesus yoo gogobi, yoŋoji momojoyaŋuŋ ruabi ŋoŋoreo foga. Ŋoŋo maŋkekerisie ogopuŋaŋuŋ yoŋoke mijeriŋaŋuŋ miku kokobo eru mi bibiŋaŋuŋ mudugaru goinebi.
Nakene momojo ŋoŋore ruaru tinane nake meneji iŋi quraŋgago: Pol.
Moji Ofoŋ so manjijojoko so eteru goga ine, Ofonji qaisoine iŋore paio ruako ropeine. Ofoŋnoŋuŋ, go wareigoŋ!
Ofoŋ Yesure yauŋmoririji ŋoŋoke peine.
Kristo Yesuke qakatoru dimagobi, nonde manjokoji sosowo ŋoŋoke peku mifia ŋareko goinebi. Buŋo oi foriine. Oŋu.
